name: Proximity Scale Grid
description: Scattered icon and label cards that scale up smoothly as the pointer comes near them and ease back when it leaves, powered by GSAP.
contents: Scattered cards, each with an icon image, title and slight rotation
behavior: Each card scales based on pointer distance to its center within a radius
Cards ease back to normal scale when the pointer leaves the grid
Works with touch through pointer events
editableByProps: Cards: icons, titles, positions in percent and rotation
Influence radius, max scale, easing and durations, grid height

needsCodeEdit.where: span with font-semibold text-sm inside proximity-card

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Grid stage is capped at 900px wide and 85vh tall; card positions are percentages of it
